title: 哈克定调：加息短而浅，长端才是关键
speaker: Patrick Harker

segments.en: So we're calling it a hiking cycle, but I don't think it's going to be a long cycle. Let's be clear.
segments.zh: 我们称之为加息周期，但我认为不会是一个长周期。这一点要明确。

segments.en: I think it's going to be this increase probably one in December, they'll probably kick off in October because of the proximity to the elections that may be one more next year.
segments.zh: 我认为这次加息之后，可能12月还有一次，10月可能因临近选举而启动，明年或许还有一次。

segments.en: If you think about where we were, we were when we look back probably slightly accommodative. Now we're moving to slightly restrictive. So we're not raising rates tremendously. And why?
segments.zh: 回想之前，我们可能略偏宽松。现在正转向略偏限制性。所以加息幅度并不大。为什么呢？

segments.en: I mean, because inflation has been running well above the Fed's target for a long time, maybe not so well above now, but it's still been a long time. And so the credibility of the Fed was on the line.
segments.zh: 因为通胀长期远高于美联储目标，也许现在没那么高了，但持续已久。所以美联储的信誉受到考验。

segments.en: And Worsh gave his speech in Jackson Hole and he had to walk the talk. He had to raise rates at this meeting, I believe.
segments.zh: 沃什在杰克逊霍尔发表了讲话，他必须言行一致。我相信他不得不在这次会议上加息。

segments.en: What do you foresee for next year then? What do you think inflation is going to be given that some of these economic forces, whether it's this AI boom, oil prices in some ways, especially what's happening in the Middle East or are similarly out of the Fed's control?
segments.zh: 那么您对明年有何预判？考虑到AI热潮、油价以及中东局势等经济力量同样不在美联储掌控之中，您认为通胀会怎样？

segments.en: Yeah. And we'll mention one other thing. So I don't think these increases are going to do a whole lot to curb inflation. Some, but not a whole lot, because the long end of the curve, the 10 year, the 30 year,
segments.zh: 是的。还要提一点。我认为这些加息对抑制通胀作用有限。有一些，但不会太大，因为长端曲线，10年期、30年期，

segments.en: that's being driven, as you said, by other forces, whether it's the AI investments crowding out government, borrowing just the amount of deficits that we're running and the money that the treasuries were putting into the market, all of that is driving up those long rates.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，长端利率受其他力量驱动，无论是AI相关配置挤出政府借贷，还是我们运行的赤字规模以及国债投放市场的资金，所有这些都在推高长端利率。

segments.en: That's what people care about, right? That's their credit card rate. That's their auto long rate. And so I don't see them coming down, even with the Fed increase, now, run the counterfactual, what did the Fed buy today?
segments.zh: 这才是人们关心的，对吧？这是他们的信用卡利率，是他们的汽车贷款利率。所以我看不到它们会下降，即使美联储加息。现在做个反事实推演，美联储今天换来了什么？

segments.en: They bought the fact that if they didn't raise the Fed funds rate, you're going to see those long rates go up. So they at least dampened down those rates, at least what the rates could have done.
segments.zh: 他们换来了一个事实：如果不提高联邦基金利率，长端利率就会上升。所以他们至少抑制了这些利率，至少限制了利率可能的上行。
